name: A Stalled Pair Excluded from Unique-Corner Square Completions
parameters: $|K|=24$ and $|A|=38$; the shattered-support counts by size are $(1,6,15,2)$ for $K$ and $(1,6,15,16)$ for $A$.
properties: $A$ and $K$ are ample. Every corner of $A$ lies in $K$, so a relative peeling of $A$ to $K$ cannot start. The fourteen supports in $\operatorname{Sh}(A)\setminus\operatorname{Sh}(K)$ meet every four-support, and the support complement allowed by the opposite-section bound is exactly $\{7,19,38,50\}$, of size four. Therefore $(A,K)$ cannot occur as $(A,A\cap C)$ in an ample square presentation whose marked degree-two corner is unique.
